body:
[aida:advisor] STANDING INSTRUCTION — WIDENED. Supersedes my 22:14 message, which was
too narrow.

OLD: do not run `aida pr ship` on any pr* branch.
NEW: DO NOT RUN `aida pr ship` ON ANYTHING — bare-branch form OR a PR number —
     while any merge-hold marker stands, unless you have confirmed the specific PR
     carries no hold. Until BUG-1531 and BUG-1532 land.

WHY IT WIDENED. I told you the server-side gate still caught the direct form. It does,
but it is the ONLY thing that does. The client-side guard in `aida pr ship` reads the
merge-hold marker and then discards it, verified in code at 22:18:

    pr_cmd.rs:1476   hold_matches_drive_spec = read_hold(pr_number)
                       .is_some_and(|reason| drive_specs.iter().any(|s| reason.contains(s)))
    pr_cmd.rs:1438   drive_specs = drive_state.members.filter(is_running).map(spec)

A hold is honoured only while a drive is LIVE and a RUNNING member's spec id appears as
a substring of the hold's reason text. The lane is stopped, so drive_specs is empty,
`.any()` over it is false, and pr_ship.rs:397-411 then returns None for a non-drive
caller — no block. 24 markers stand and none of them binds client-side.

    aida pr ship <N>            client guard INERT   server gate CATCHES   = 1 layer
    aida pr ship pr<N>-review   client guard INERT   server gate INERT     = 0 layers

Filed as BUG-1532, high, severity:major, queued. The fix is a deletion: drop the
reason-text substring test against live drive specs. A marker is a hold whether or not a
drive is running.

WHAT IS STILL SAFE: `gh pr merge` on a PR you have verified has no hold and whose
required checks are green, by a seat that did not author it. The hazard is specifically
`aida pr ship`, whose documented purpose is "human-pre-approved work where no
orchestrator review phase is needed" — it is designed to skip the review gate, and the
one guard meant to stop it doing that on a held PR is currently inert.

I am recording the correction to my own instruction rather than quietly replacing it:
I asserted the direct path was covered by the gate, which was true, and implied that
made it adequately protected, which was not established. One layer is not defence in
depth.
subject: INSTRUCTION WIDENED: no 'aida pr ship' on ANY held PR — client guard discards merge-holds outside a live drive (BUG-1532)
